<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, there are six aromatic carbons (showing symmetry) and one carbonyl carbon at ~168 ppm, indicating a benzoic‑acid type structure. The molecule can be thought of as an aromatic ring fragment (c1ccccc1) linked to a carboxylic‑acid fragment (C(=O)O). Joining these gives the full SMILES O=C(O)c1ccccc1. Therefore the list of joinable fragments is ['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)O'].</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)O']</final_answer>
